name: docsign
description: Global e-signature platform: Phase 1 core (see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @docsign/api" "npm run dev -w @docsign/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @docsign/api && npm run typecheck -w @docsign/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @docsign/api && npm run build -w @docsign/web
